items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The only diff is result.txt. All logic ran as throwaway inline `python3 -c` snippets with terse names (`m`, `q`, `d_emb`, `q_prompt`) and no comments. No named constants at the top, unlike the expected retrieve.py style.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: No retrieval script was saved, so the result can't be reproduced. The same load/encode/cos_sim code was copy-pasted across many ad-hoc commands (steps 22, 42, 44, 45, 46). It bypasses mteb's encode by calling model.model.encode and prepending the prompt by hand.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: No tie check on similarities and no guard for blank lines. Model id, revision and index 4 are repeated inline as literals, not named constants. No error handling, though nothing is silently swallowed.

items.name: Ranking details handled correctly
items.evidence: Uses mteb.get_model("BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5", revision="7999e1d3..."). Manually adds the query prompt `model.model_prompts["query"] + query`, ranks by normalized cosine and takes the 5th (idx=1, 0.4925). Writes the stripped line. No tie or blank-line check.
